name: STA414H1 — Socratic Discovery (Deep Learning Fundamentals)
description: Neural networks: layers of neurons. Each neuron: z = w·x + b, a = σ(z) (activation function). Universal Approximation Theorem: a single hidden layer w

steps.template_en: Neural networks: layers of neurons. Each neuron: z = w·x + b, a = σ(z) (activation function). Universal Approximation Theorem: a single hidden layer with enough neurons can approximate ANY continuous function on a compact set.
steps.template_zh: 神经网络：神经元层。通用近似定理：足够神经元的单隐层可逼近紧集上任何连续函数。

steps.template_en: Backpropagation: compute gradients via chain rule. Forward pass: compute activations layer by layer. Backward pass: compute ∂Loss/∂w for each weight. Gradient descent: w ← w - η·∂L/∂w.
steps.template_zh: 反向传播：通过链式法则算梯度。前向：逐层计算激活。反向：算每权重∂Loss/∂w。梯度下降。

steps.template_en: Activation functions: (1) Sigmoid: 1/(1+e^{-x}) — saturates, vanishing gradient. (2) ReLU: max(0,x) — non-saturating, faster. (3) Tanh: (e^x-e^{-x})/(e^x+e^{-x}). (4) Softmax: e^{zᵢ}/Σe^{zⱼ} for classification.
steps.template_zh: 激活函数：(1)Sigmoid——饱和、梯度消失。(2)ReLU——不饱和、更快。(3)Tanh。(4)Softmax用于分类。

steps.template_en: Training challenges: (1) Vanishing/exploding gradients (use ReLU, batch norm, residual connections). (2) Overfitting (dropout, data augmentation, weight decay). (3) Local minima (plateaus, saddle points). (4) Learning rate tuning (Adam optimizer).
steps.template_zh: 训练挑战：(1)梯度消失/爆炸(ReLU、批归一化)。(2)过拟合(dropout、数据增强)。(3)局部极小。(4)学习率调节(Adam)。

steps.template_en: In R/TensorFlow: (1) Build a 2-hidden-layer net for MNIST. (2) Use ReLU activations. (3) Train with Adam. (4) Add dropout for regularization. (5) Compare with logistic regression.
steps.template_zh: 在R/TensorFlow中：(1)为MNIST建2隐层网络。(2)用ReLU。(3)用Adam训练。(4)加dropout正则化。(5)与逻辑回归比较。

steps.template_en: Deep learning's power: learn HIERARCHICAL representations — early layers detect edges, middle layers detect shapes, late layers detect objects. This hierarchy LEARNED, not hand-crafted. More data + more compute → better performance.
steps.template_zh: 深度学习力量：学习层次表示——早期检边、中层检形状、晚期检物体。层次是学习来的，不是手工设计的。
